reviews.text: Professionalism and true love: thank you, Doc!
He's been taking care of our dogs for years, and we've been quite happy with him. The fees are a bit high for certain medical services.
Claudio is a true cat lover. That's why I go there. He's conscientious, thorough, patient, and very professional. He makes you feel at ease. I think he's the only one of his kind. Highly recommended.

I've been to several well-known clinics and veterinary practices. One day, a friend recommended Claudio to me. More than 20 years have passed since then.
I don't think you'll find anyone more professional, sincere, and honest than him!
Claudio is number one, I will always thank him, my dog ​​Lucky lived for 19 years, thanks to his professionalism and competence!!!

A highly competent and compassionate doctor with enormous passion, he's dedicated to their well-being and provides concise and direct advice to his fellow humans. He has a wonderful assistant, Doriana, who has always been with him. He's very fair about pricing and can handle emergencies with ease. Even if he's incredibly busy, he'll call you directly if it's important, and he knows each of us personally. Being his client is truly a guarantee. Unfortunately, there are some jealous gossips.
Very welcoming veterinary practice, very welcoming professional doctors.
From Dr. Panico, seriousness, competence and a heart of gold who loves animals

I promised myself I'd write about my experience with Dr. Panico. We found him through word of mouth and went to him with a problem with our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel. After undergoing tests, exams, and food changes, IVs, day hospitalization, and a lot of money, previous vets still couldn't figure out what to do. From the first visit, Dr. Panico made Willy feel better. He was his doctor until the end. What strikes you about the doctor is his love for animals, his care and expertise, and his no-nonsense, practical approach. He's to the point and concise in his answers, but he always knows how to give you the right advice and effective treatment. I read someone wrote that he doesn't answer because he's too busy. I can say that even when he didn't respond immediately (remember, it's not a 24-hour clinic), he always called me back shortly afterward, and he always responded to every message. One Sunday morning when Willy was feeling sick, I called him, and he had me come to the office, opening it just for us. Honest in their care, honest in their costs, honest in their disclosures. We returned with our new four-legged friend, confident in the knowledge that we're receiving the best care the market has to offer. They have an equally knowledgeable and helpful assistant. They are two genuine people who don't just fulfill a role, but bring that extra value to the work they do. Thank you for your work.
